notice.title: Notice to our guests — 14 July 2026
notice.short: Temporary closure · Stays cancelled with a full refund.
notice.body: Following the instructions of the archipelago authorities, and as a precaution due to instability at the glacier front, the Arca remains temporarily closed. All scheduled stays have been cancelled and will be refunded in full. Reopening expected within the next 72 hours.

home.title:
Where time
stands still
home.subtitle: A place apart from the world. A different way to inhabit it.
home.introTitle:
Some places take you somewhere.
Others take you away from everything.
home.intro: 120 kilometres along the coast from Longyearbyen, between a silent inlet and the ancient pulse of a glacier, a new idea of hospitality takes shape. Concrete, timber and light. The essential, taken a little further.
zeros: An ambition guiding every decision. Efficient systems, electric mobility and a more considered relationship with this place.
Glass, timber and an acoustic joint. Hear only what deserves to be heard.
The sun need not leave. You need not look at the clock.
home.quote: “The new luxury is not having more. It is allowing the rest of the world to feel, at last, far away.”
home.suiteText: Three ways to retreat. The same attention to the unseen.
home.experiencesTitle:
The measure of a day
is yours to decide.
home.auroraText: Ten metres of glass. A table for twelve. An uninterrupted landscape.
home.wellnessText: The warmth of water. The stillness of ice. A return to the essential.
home.expeditionsText: Beyond the glass, the Arctic keeps all its questions.

arca.title:
Designed
to disappear.
arca.intro: A horizontal gesture on the hillside. Architecture that does not compete with the Arctic: it learns to be quiet.
sections: Material and landscape
Dark concrete extends the rock. Laminated timber brings a warmth that needs no explanation. The building steps into the slope, preserving the horizon from every room.
Silence is built, too
The Aurora Lounge is separated from the main building by an independent acoustic joint. So the glasses never tremble. So a conversation never has to rise above a whisper.
A considered envelope
Triple glazing, heat recovery and heat pumps adapt comfort to the archipelago climate. Zero footprint is our direction of travel, not a claim of certified zero emissions.
arca.planTitle: A different way to be, at every level.
levels: Main level · Aurora, restaurant, gallery and garden
arca.crown: A fine line above the roof. A single red point in the sky. Our spire guides pilots and navigators by night.
arca.crownNote: In summer, a discreet presence. In the polar night, a point of reference.

aurora.title:
The horizon
has a table.
aurora.intro: A curved glass wall ten metres high. The inlet straight ahead. The glacier to the left. Nothing else between you and this place.
aurora.table: One piece of mahogany. Twelve guests. Saturday dinners find their rhythm here: courses arriving without hurry, conversations with no need to end.
aurora.bar: Our bar interprets the north in precise glasses. Botanicals, saline notes and just enough warmth. Alcohol-free, too.
cocktails: Gin, juniper, green apple and a saline note.
Japanese whisky, birch and aromatic bitters.
aurora.camNote: A window onto the Aurora, wherever you are.

suites.title:
The space
to do nothing.
suites.intro: Linen, stone and timber. Three ways to close the door and open the horizon.

items.name: Garden Suites
items.body: A step from the glazed gallery, four trees in monumental planters accompany the passage. “The Hand”, a bronze sculpture by Einar Velde, seems to offer silence.
features: Reading lounge and individual climate control

items.name: Upper Suites
items.body: Three-metre windows above the water. An elevated perspective and a light that changes without disappearing. Here the landscape is part of the room.
features: Bathtub, rain shower and underfloor heating
Binoculars and a selection of Arctic books

items.name: Crown Suite
items.body: The highest residence at the Arca. A private pantry, an intimate dining room and the privilege of needing nothing more.

suites.gardenText: Four trees. A bronze hand. The garden gallery is a pause within a pause.

dining.title:
The north,
served slowly.
dining.intro: Ingredient-led Nordic cuisine. Season, provenance and a precise touch. Nothing to hide what matters.
sections: The restaurant
Cold-water fish, seasonal vegetables and house-made preserves. A short menu shaped by availability and our kitchen’s judgement. Every menu can be adapted to your allergies and preferences.
A cellar without latitude
Great Bordeaux wines, vintages selected for their balance and a collection of Japanese whiskies to linger over. A journey can happen in a glass.
Saturdays at the Aurora
Twelve places at the captain’s table. A tasting menu conceived to share the rhythm of the landscape. The light changes; the conversation continues.
dining.menuNote: Illustrative seasonal selection. Menu subject to availability.

wellness.title:
Return
to your own warmth.
wellness.intro: Warm water facing the ice. The body discovers a different scale for rest.
wellness.spa: Sauna, personalised treatments and an outdoor hot tub open to the glacier. A circuit designed to restore calm, without counting the minutes.
wellness.med: Our diagnostic capsule combines an examination bed and a sensor dome. Precision medicine connected in real time with our specialists in Zurich.
wellness.medNote: Individual assessment under the supervision of Dr Anya Tamm. Any examination requires professional indication and informed consent. This service does not replace emergency care.

expeditions.title:
The world
beyond the glass.
expeditions.intro: To venture out is a choice. To discover, a privilege. Our guides accompany every step, every crossing and every return.
items: The glacier, at the right distance
Read the landscape, ice and geology with specialist guides. Routes follow the conditions and always avoid calving zones.
Still water and a light that never ends. Small groups, dry suits and a route decided by the sea.
The season of the northern lights
In winter, excursions to observe the polar sky. Nature decides when to raise the curtain.
A snowmobile fleet for authorised winter routes and electric quad bikes for permitted summer journeys.
expeditions.safety: Every outing is led by armed guides carrying polar bear deterrents, in accordance with the safety measures applicable in Svalbard. Never venture out alone or approach wildlife. Routes depend on the weather and instructions from the authorities.
expeditions.suspended: No expeditions operate during the temporary closure.

gallery.title:
Chosen objects.
Nothing more.
gallery.intro: On the main level, an intimate selection of fine watches, high jewellery and luxury technical clothing. Pieces to accompany a journey. Or to remember it.
shops: Precision mechanics and extraordinarily restrained designs. Private appointments to discover each piece.
Precious metals, singular stones and a selection that prefers to whisper.
Technical layers, natural fibres and garments designed for comfort at extreme latitudes.
gallery.photoIntro: Material, light and the constant presence of the landscape.

arrival.title:
Far from everything.
Close to the essential.
arrival.intro: Your journey begins in Longyearbyen. The final 120 kilometres along the coast are part of the stay.
steps: Flights to Longyearbyen from Oslo and Tromsø. Frequencies and connections vary by season.
A coordinated helicopter transfer to our private helipad, subject to weather and operational conditions.
Alternatively, a boat transfer to the hotel pier. Our team coordinates your luggage and arrival.
arrival.note: All guest transfers are suspended while the resort is closed. Do not travel to the Arca without express confirmation from our team.

reservations.title:
We look forward to welcoming you.
When the time is right.
reservations.intro: Our team is assisting guests affected by the temporary closure. Thank you for your understanding.
reservations.disabled: The booking engine is disabled. No new requests or payments are accepted.
faq: Yes. All scheduled stays have been cancelled as a precaution. There is no need to request a separate cancellation.
Will I receive a full refund?
Yes. The full amount paid for your stay will be refunded to the original payment method. Processing times depend on the issuing institution.
Should I send my bank details?
No. We will not ask for card numbers, passwords or payments through this website to arrange a refund. For enquiries, email only your booking reference.
The initial estimate was 72 hours. Update: until further notice. Reopening is subject to authorisation by the authorities.
We can discuss a new stay once reopening is confirmed. For now, we cannot guarantee dates or availability.
reservations.phone: Telephone line temporarily out of service
reservations.mailNote: Reservations and affected stays are being handled exclusively by email.

team.title:
Care
has a name.
team.intro: Four perspectives. One idea of hospitality: anticipate, care and be there when it matters.
people: Every detail matters. Especially the one a guest never notices.
Comfort begins long before a light is switched on.
Distance should never change the quality of care.
An extraordinary place demands an equally ambitious vision.

legal.title:
Clarity
is a service, too.
legal.intro: Editorial information, privacy and terms of use for this website.
sections: Legal notice

ARCA-∅ is a fictional place from the novel “Arca-∅” by A. Riven. This website is part of its narrative universe. The facilities, team, press quotation, medical services and closure notice are fictional. There is no real accommodation offer and no contracts can be entered into through this website.
Terms of use

The content serves a cultural and promotional purpose for the novel. Images are generated recreations made for this project, not photographs of a real hotel. Travel information is contextual and must not be used to plan expeditions. The work’s texts and identity belong to their respective rights holders.
Privacy

This website has no submission forms, accounts, payments or analytics. Language selection lasts only for the visit and is not saved in your browser. Images and fonts are served from the site’s hosting. GitHub Pages may process technical connection data, including IP addresses, under its own privacy policy.
Email contact

Email links open your email application. Only if you send a message will your provider and the recipient process the included data. Do not send medical or financial information or identity documents. The displayed email may be a configuration placeholder, not an operational service.
Cookies

This site sets no first-party or third-party cookies and uses no local storage for tracking. It has no advertising pixels or embedded third-party video. Accordingly, no cookie consent panel is displayed.
